errors.text_span: Диаграмата е разделена на пет сектора
errors.evidence: The pie chart is visually divided into three sectors (blue, red, and orange). The legend lists five possible categories, but only three of them are represented with slices in the chart.

errors.text_span: докато зеленият и лилавият сектори не са етикетирани с проценти и визуално изглеждат значително по-малки от останалите три
errors.evidence: The description claims that the green and purple sectors are present as small slices without percentage labels. In fact, these sectors are not present in the chart at all, as they represent 0% of the responses.
The description includes the green and purple sectors in its account of the ordering of the slices. These sectors do not exist in the visual representation of the chart.
